---
title: "Giraffe Social Networks"
date: "2022-04-26"
description: "Static and dynamic social network analysis uncovers association patterns in desert-dwelling giraffe."
categories: [paper]
---

[Emma E. Hart](https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Emma-E-Hart-2176499576),
[Simone Ciuti](https://sites.google.com/ucd.ie/wildl-ecol-behav-at-ucd),
[Leticia Herrmann](https://www.linkedin.com/in/leticiaherrmann/),
[Julian Fennessy](https://giraffeconservation.org/our-team/),
[Emma Wells](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emma-wells-54453330/), and
[Michael Salter-Townshend](../index.qmd) have published an article in [*Behavioral Ecology and Sociobiology*](https://link.springer.com/journal/265):

**[Static and dynamic methods in social network analysis reveal the association patterns of desert-dwelling giraffe](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00265-022-03167-9)**
